revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The new readings look good. — Leave space before [το]ῖ̣ς̣ (l. 15). I have no views on the accentuation of Kirka.
Submit - Fixing a minor typo, additional reading.

Commit - In l. 22, Leiden+, for reasons unknown, shows an error when the diaeresis is used <:Ε̣ ὖ̣(¨)τος=BL 1.78|ed|ἐ̣ ῦ̣(¨)τ̣ος:> (no errors when removed). Therefore, I've removed it to be able to save the file.

Commit - Changes in l. 15 [ ̣ ̣ ̣] ̣λ̣ι εὐ̣ ̣ ̣ τ̣ῆς ̣ρ̣ ̣α ̣ ̣ ̣ => [ ̣ ̣το]ῖ̣ς̣ ἁλιεῦσ̣ι τῆς Κ[ί]ρ̣κα, ὅπω\ς̣/ (I prefer the paroxytone form of the village's name); in l. 22 a minor typo θαλλοῦ => Θαλλοῦ.
Finalized - Ready. Underdots in lin22 added.

Submit - Entered BL corrections to lines 7 and 28–9, but in the latter passage I report BL XIII 28 selectively: I have not included ἐρρῶσθαί [σ]ε̣ εὔ̣χομαι, | κύριέ μου, π̣[ο]λλοῖ[ς] χ̣ρόνοις | εὐθυμοῦν̣τ̣α̣, as it is hardly useful to record disagreements with very old editions over dots and brackets when the word remains the same. || lines 10 & 22 (bis) bgu 3 p.8 => BL 1.78 || lin22 I had to undot upsilon before diaeresis to avoid the usual problem; check before finalizing.
